reason: Re-opened packet.js quran 32 --verse 17.78. The reading holds: al-Tabari reports dulūk as sunset (Maghrib) and as the sun's leaning at noon (Zuhr), and prefers leaning (wa-awla al-qawlayn bi-l-sawab), adding in his own words that when the sun passes the zenith (zalat ʿan kabid al-samaʾ) it has leaned toward setting, the time of the noon prayer, so 'past midday' is his; he prefers the prayer at ghasaq al-layl as Maghrib alone, ghasaq being the night's coming on. Both evidence pieces string-match; verse.js ok (Al-Isra 17:78, at 2106); entry-check.js ok; plain sense faithful (17:76 those who would drive him forth, 17:77 the unchanging way, 17:78 to 17:79 times of worship). The locator fails: the digitisation's seg is labelled 17:77 to 17:78, but inside it al-Tabari has his own heading for 17:78 (al-qawl fi taʾwil qawlihi taʿala: aqim al-salat li-duluk al-shams ... (78)), and his comment on 17:77 is about God's way with nations that expel their messengers, with nothing on prayer. So the comment is not one comment on the range, and 'on 17:77 to 17:78' sends a reader to an ayah where he says none of this. The sister entry quran-01-d013-p, in the identical situation (seg 5:86 to 5:87, own heading for 5:87), cites 'on 5:87'; this entry should match. Tested: with 'on 17:78' in both s and src, entry-check.js is ok with no errors or warns.
